title: Autonomous continuous improvement protocol
human_intent: Make Prometeo safe to improve from page Captures using disposable agents: every worker must load durable global rules, preserve existing work, coordinate concurrent writes, complete the loop, return results into the page thread, and route human-facing links back through the single Universal Host.
already_decided: No competing continuity architecture; extend Agent Runtime v3, P4 Capture, Page Change Threads and existing product authorities.
One Universal Control remains the only global shell.
Page-specific continuity lives in Page Change Threads; cross-workstream coordination stays in Runtime/DELTA/RETURN.
Default mutation style is surgical preservation, not clean-slate reconstruction.
Human-facing result links must keep the user inside the Universal Host whenever possible.
known_failures: Raw child-page result links eject the user from Universal Control and Change Feed.
Declared write-scope overlap from completed recovery workstreams creates false HARD collisions.
A normal user request like 'change this' can be misread as permission to reconstruct if durable preservation rules are not mandatory.
UI Change Loop controls may inherit page palette variables and become visually unreadable.
high_value_targets: Publish a mandatory global constitution and embed its URL/digest into every compiled Work Packet.
Make live-write collision semantics distinguish active writing workers from historical/completed scopes.
Strengthen PROMETEO EXECUTE with worker claim, pre-write resync/CAS, preserve-first and completion laws.
Add Universal Host deep links for page + execution result and make Change Loop results use host-routed links.
Fix Change Loop overlay transparency and guaranteed button contrast.
Rebuild/test/publish the Universal Control and verify the public test URL.
